subject: Re: gl.filter.ld / gl.report.ld.map for small sample size

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: gl.filter.ld / gl.report.ld.map for small sample size
parts:
Hi Kristen,

As described in the function documentation, you can use the parameter "ind.limit" to set the minimum number of individuals that should have a population to be included in the calculations of LD, see code below.

Cheers,
Luis  

library(dartRverse)
t1 <- platypus.gl
# access function documentation
?gl.report.ld.map
# or
help(gl.report.ld.map)
# including pops with sample sizes up to 7 individuals
res <- gl.report.ld.map(x= t1,
                        ld.max.pairwise = 1e+07,
                        ind.limit = 7)

On Tuesday, 19 November 2024 at 8:45:37 am UTC+11 kristen...@gmail.com wrote:
Hi all,

When running 'gl.report.ld.map' is there is a way to get around this error: Skipping population 'x' from analysis because it has less than 10 individuals and force the annalysis so I can filter for ld ?

I want to run this for pops with sample sizes ranging 7 - 10.

Cheers, 
Kristen.

Try setting the limit to less than 10 via:

 

gl.report.ld.map(….,ind.limit=5)

 

or whatever you want.

 

Cheers, Bernd
